name: Northern Lights
summary: **Northern Lights** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] whose original plants were reportedly grown in the Pacific Northwest, United States, in the 1970s before being stabilized in the [[country:NL|Netherlands]] by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]]. Its exact parentage was never documented, though Afghani and Thai landraces are commonly cited as ancestors. It became the base for many later hybrids.

origin.place: Netherlands (stabilized here; original stock reportedly from the Pacific Northwest, USA)
